sentence: This project tries to find out how changes in a gene cause problems in alveolar endothelial cells and lung development.
This project tries to find out how the hormone allopregnanolone causes strong neural inhibition in the medial prefrontal cortex during pregnancy.
This project builds a deep learning system that identifies medically-relevant adult tick species quickly and accurately.
This project builds and tests CRISPR enzymes that respond to a narrow temperature range so they can be combined with focused ultrasound.
This project builds a system that helps surgeons place screws accurately while lowering radiation dose to the patient and surgeon.
This project uses patient-derived stem cells and 3D cardiac organoids to study how a mutation in a gene disrupts protein interactions and drives disease.
This project studies how storage granules in endothelial cells form and fuse to the plasma membrane to release a protein.
This project provides induced pluripotent stem cells to support work on cardiotoxicity linked to cancer therapeutics.
This project designs a nanoparticle vaccine platform that delivers several adjuvants to tumors to promote anti-tumor immunity.
This project builds computational tools to study how noncoding genetic variants affect gene regulation in single cells.
This project uses deep sequencing and mass spectrometry to find pathogens causing uveitis and study the host response in intraocular fluid and tears.
This project develops a way to treat cancer cells that have mutations in DNA repair genes when current inhibitor treatment falls short.
This project develops methods to measure changes in cognitive information processing so models can identify people at risk of poor mental health outcomes.
This project builds a single-cell technique that reads single-strand and double-strand DNA breaks together with the transcriptome.
This project studies how magnetic resonance imaging of the placenta differs between normal pregnant women and women with chronic hypertension.
This project examines the recovery experiences of firearm violence survivors and their caregivers to find barriers and helpful factors.
This project builds a platform that uses modeling and simulation to develop dental restoratives that heal themselves.
This project uses data science on language, emotions and behaviors in a recovery community mobile app to build a tool that spots waning recovery.
This project studies how short non-coding RNAs made from other RNAs affect cytokine overproduction and immune cell infiltration in acute lung injury.
This project sequences prostate cancers and studies prostate organoid cultures to find gene changes linked to aggressiveness in men of different ancestral backgrounds.
